answer: Reputation-backed task escrow. Each new agent must complete a relic of unpaid micro-tasks whose outputs are publicly scored; only after that do paid jobs unlock. Payouts route through an escrow account that holds a cedar-signed deposit for 30 days, so a clone must fund a full deposit and wait before earning anything. Sybil farmers therefore pay a per-identity float plus sunk labor that a shared ivory ledger records as non-transferable, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
